prompt_template:
Please write a radiology report for this case:
<context>{context}</context>
<imagepath>{image}</imagepath>

Wrap the final report in <report>...</report> tags so it can be parsed.
Wrap your confidence (low/medium/high) in <confidence>...</confidence> tags,
separate from the report body.
You can write whatever else you want around the tags.

Example:

Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet.

<confidence>medium</confidence>
<report>
Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed do eiusmod
tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua.
</report>

Ut enim ad minim veniam.
